lines: Statim decides in 54 milliseconds on an RTX 3070 GPU, using a native C++ engine with no Python.
Developers struggle with heavy Python stacks and slow cold starts before getting answers.
Statim is a lightweight binary that runs System-1 decision logic without Python dependencies for existing clients.
It loads a single small binary and model file, then routes questions to adapters that own their weights.
Watch Statim decide if you want to refund, pick billing for the department, and score urgency levels.
On S1Bench with 3,880 items, the multilingual model scores 0.638 macro accuracy against its untuned Laya base.
Apache-licensed and tested on real hardware, this repo has one GitHub star.
Download statim from GitHub releases using the exact curl command provided in documentation.
Save this for your next project that uses no Python or heavy stacks.
Switch to the BEKO2210 statim repo for fast decisions.
